tasks.short: Direct teachers and administrators at daycare centers.

steps.what: Direct and coordinate activities of teachers
Coordinate administrators at daycare centers or schools
Work with public agencies or institutions
Sign the coordination note
File the signed coordination note
outputs: filed copy of signed coordination note v1

tasks.design: Directing teachers and coordinating administrators at daycare centers, schools, public agencies, or institutions stays with the administrator. A job files the note in {DOCS} only after it is signed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A shared plan could look like direction that nobody had given.
tasks.enabler_now: The signed note can be filed from the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: What the day should be is decided with the people in it.
tasks.altitude: Direction stays. Filing the signed note shrinks.

reach.learn: What was left to their judgement

evidence.claim: The manager digest says curriculum, people, and marketing stay manual, with drafting help only.

assumptions: The job does not direct a teacher.
Nothing is sent as an instruction before signature.
unknowns: Which agencies expect a written note.
research_questions: How often the day plan changes after the morning.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on directing teachers is the direction itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every direction is still given in person. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer retyped. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor students' progress and help resolve problems.

steps.what: Show attendance counts with no learning score
Monitor students' progress with their teachers
Provide students with assistance resolving problems
Sign the assistance note for this student
File the signed assistance note
outputs: filed copy of signed assistance note v1

tasks.design: A dashboard in {BI} shows attendance counts and does not score learning. The administrator monitors students' progress with teachers and provides assistance resolving problems. They sign the note. A job files that version. There is no automated outcome.
tasks.previous_blocker: An attendance figure could be read as a judgement on the child.
tasks.enabler_now: Attendance counts can be shown from the existing register.
tasks.still_hard: What help a child needs is still seen in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator decides the assistance and remains responsible for it.
tasks.altitude: The monitoring and the assistance stay. The count is no longer copied by hand.

reach.learn: That a count is not a judgement

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] treats hiring, staff evaluation, admissions, and learning outcomes as high-risk, and digest [S11] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so this design produces no score of a child or a staff member.
Digest [S9] says scholarship, admission, and staff decisions must not rest on automation alone, so hiring, evaluation, and a child's place stay with the administrator.

assumptions: A parent is not told an outcome by a job.
unknowns: Which progress notes may be stored.
research_questions: How often attendance is missing for a day.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on monitoring is the conversation with the teacher, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every child of concern is still seen. The high end assumes only the attendance count is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set program scope and draft schedules and staffing.

steps.what: Determine the scope of educational program offerings
Estimate staffing and facility requirements from the ratio
Prepare drafts of program schedules and descriptions
Sign the program schedule and description
File the signed program schedule
outputs: filed copy of signed program schedule v1

tasks.design: The administrator determines the scope of educational program offerings. A configured ratio in {SPREADSHEET} estimates staffing and facility requirements as a headcount, not a named roster. The administrator prepares the schedule and the description, signs them, and a job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: A timetable could be published before the scope was decided.
tasks.enabler_now: A ratio table can total a headcount in the tool already used.
tasks.still_hard: What the program should offer is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator sets the scope and signs the schedule.

ambition.what: Re-estimate the headcount when enrollment changes, and sign the schedule again.

tasks.altitude: The scope and the wording stay. The headcount arithmetic shrinks.

reach.learn: That the ratio is not an assignment

evidence.claim: The manager digest says a schedule is set in the configured tool, and a model is not used to set it.
Digest [S12] says rosters and staff data need works-council consent, so this design estimates a headcount and does not assign named people from behaviour.
The manager digest says curriculum, people, and marketing stay manual, with drafting help only.

assumptions: Native configuration of the ratio comes before custom code.
No named person is assigned by the job.
unknowns: Whether a works council must see a later named roster.
research_questions: How often enrollment differs from the figure used.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the scope step is the decision itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the schedule text is still written by the administrator. The high end assumes only the headcount is no longer worked by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate programs for efficiency, compliance, and changes.

steps.what: List current programs against stored regulations
Review and evaluate efficiency and effectiveness
Determine compliance with state, local, and federal regulations
Recommend any necessary modifications
Sign the program evaluation
File the signed program evaluation
outputs: filed copy of signed program evaluation v1

tasks.design: A job lists current programs and the regulations already stored in {DOCS}. It does not judge them. The administrator reviews efficiency and effectiveness, determines compliance with state, local, and federal regulations, and recommends modifications. They sign the evaluation. A cited rule with no stored row is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated compliance claim could cite a rule that was never opened.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored program and regulation titles can be listed without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a program is effective, and what to change, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator makes the recommendation and remains responsible for it.

ambition.what: Review a program again when a stored regulation changes, and sign a new evaluation.

tasks.altitude: The evaluation stays. Listing the stored titles shrinks.

evidence.claim: Digest [S15] records that a model-drafted review cited sources that did not exist and a court case that was fabricated, so every cited clause or figure must match a source row.
The manager digest says curriculum, people, and marketing stay manual, with drafting help only.

assumptions: The job does not invent a regulation.
Nothing is sent as a compliance claim before signature.
unknowns: Which regulations apply to this centre.
research_questions: How often a stored regulation is out of date.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the review is the evaluation itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every program is still read by the administrator. The high end assumes only the index of stored titles is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The childcare administrator spends the week with children, parents, and staff. Tables and filing a signed note move to a job. No model hires, evaluates, or scores a child or a staff member.
reach: Parents hear about a child from the administrator, not from a generated note.
Teachers receive only the schedule or the action the administrator signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a headcount from a decision to hire or to change a program.
Reject a draft sentence that cites a code or a figure with no source row.
role.ambitious_version: A signed purchase or funding pack can go out the same week, and the administrator still authorizes it.

job.title: Education and Childcare Administrators, Preschool and Daycare
